# SVG Optimizer
> Online Vector Graphics Cleaner & Minifier (100% Client-Side)

## Project Overview
SVG Optimizer is a fast, lightweight, and privacy-conscious web utility created to strip metadata, editor bloat, unnecessary XML declarations, and redundant precision from Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG).

## Canonical URL
https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/svgoptimizer/

## Core Features
- In-browser parsing and minification using native JavaScript regex & DOM manipulation.
- Strips Inkscape, Adobe Illustrator, Figma, and Sketch proprietary namespaces and metadata.
- Decimal coordinate precision rounding (1, 2, or 3 decimals) to drastically reduce path coordinate lengths.
- Real-time live visual rendered preview with checkered transparency grid.
- Calculates absolute byte and percentage savings instantly.
- 100% client-side: Zero file transmission or backend storage.

## Target Audience
Frontend web developers, UI/UX engineers, technical writers, and digital designers needing lightweight inline SVGs.
